mutations.name: M1 the mapper stops branching on task_complete.error, so a failed turn publishes as a success
mutations.expectRed: live:and RUN_ERROR was emitted anyway, from task_complete.error

mutations.name: M2 the mapper stops withholding user and developer records
mutations.expectRed: live:NO event carries a withheld record's id as its messageId

mutations.name: M3 the tool identity becomes a synthesized key instead of the native call_id
mutations.expectRed: shape:TOOL_CALL_START carries the NATIVE call_id, not a synthesized key

mutations.name: M4 a list-shaped tool output silently serializes to nothing, so one of the two real shapes is dropped
mutations.replace:
if (typeof o === "string") return o;
  if (Array.isArray(o)) return "";
mutations.expectRed: shape:and the LIST output's content actually reaches the event

mutations.name: M5 turn_aborted requires a turn id, turning a rare heterogeneity into a dead stream
mutations.replace:
if (turn === undefined) return null;
      const id = turn;
mutations.expectRed: shape:turn_aborted WITHOUT a turn id still ends the run

mutations.name: M6 the run stops being fenced on its turn, so any turn's completion closes it
mutations.expectRed: shape:a task_complete for a DIFFERENT turn emits NOTHING

mutations.name: M7 the opaque reasoning blob is published alongside the summary
mutations.find:
if (text.length === 0) return null;
      const messageId = asString(payload.id) ?? `rsn:${runId}:${ts}`;

mutations.name: M8 TOOL_CALL_RESULT loses the stable messageId every connector owes
mutations.expectRed: shape:TOOL_CALL_RESULT carries the messageId every connector owes, derived from the call id

mutations.name: M9 the mapper reads a record's fields without checking it is one, so a null JSONL line throws and kills the plane
mutations.find: if (record === null || typeof record !== "object") return null;
mutations.expectRed: degenerate:a null JSONL line is DROPPED, not thrown on

mutations.name: M10 the stated gap is filled by analogy: a built-in tool's END record is published as a result for a call nothing ever started
mutations.expectRed: gap:no tool event is published for the built-in family

mutations.name: M11 the object shape of task_complete.error stops being read, so a real failure loses its message and its code
mutations.find: const message = asString(errRecord?.message) ?? errText ?? "codex turn failed";
mutations.expectRed: error:the dict shape becomes RUN_ERROR carrying its message and code

mutations.name: M12 only the object shape counts as a failure, so an error arriving as a bare string is published as a finished run
mutations.find: const failed = payload.error !== null && payload.error !== undefined;
mutations.expectRed: error:a bare string error is a FAILED run, not a finished one
